Evidence/NEG-EW-011
Evidence record

Wallet service named in a June 2024 CBY-Aden list of unlicensed services

What does this evidence establish?

We Cash electronic payment services is one of 12 names in a 26 June 2024 circular of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) listing services that CBY-Aden considered unlicensed on that date and with which banks and exchange businesses were told not to deal. Its status under any other authority, and its status after that date, are not established here.

What does it measure?

One service named as unlicensed in a circular of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) dated 26 June 2024.

Who or what does it apply to?

Only this one of the 12 names listed in the circular.

When was it measured or observed?

26 June 2024

How current is it?

The circular is dated 26 June 2024. It does not describe the service's status after that date.

What this evidence does not establish

The unlicensed status applies to 26 June 2024 and is not a 2026 status; later status, including any licensing, is not tracked here. A list of unlicensed names does not identify which services are licensed, and the circular does not establish the service's status under any other authority.
